source.name: Israel Ports & Shipping Authority NtM 113/2024 + TAMA 37/A/2/7 statutory blueprint (plan 1053432)

resolutions.researcher_notes: Centerline from two independent official vector sources, spliced at 31.8747N 34.5828E (66 m agreement at the seam). Ashdod-side ~9.2 km = midline of the green pipeline strip (רצועת צנרת, ~350 m wide) color-segmented from the TAMA 37/A/2/7 marine blueprint - a scanned sheet georeferenced by JGW world file (EPSG:2039, 1.02 m/px; exact registration, no GCP fit; GIS bundle https://apps.land.gov.il/IturTabotData/download/jerus/1053432.zip, plan ratified by cabinet decision 1260 of 27.02.2022) - starting at the HDD shore-crossing compound (the true Ashdod landfall). Remainder ~32 km = midline of the ~1.0 km-wide pipe-lay works corridor published as a 23-point coordinate polygon in NtM 113/2024 (ref 4000-0709-2024-0000908; vertices pair 1:1 across the band, 0.99-1.05 km all pairs; derivation script derive_p3657_midline.py in this staging dir). The two sources agree: NtM midline runs parallel to the statutory strip at 0-480 m offset where both exist. Corroborated by INGL's official transmission map (https://www.ingl.co.il/en/holancha/, big-map JPG) showing the statutory line bowing offshore Ashdod reception -> Ashkelon reception. Positional uncertainty ±175 m (blueprint portion) / ±500 m (NtM portion) -> suggested RouteAccuracy medium (downgraded from the gis high cap). Geodesic 41.66 km vs sheet 42 km (ratio 0.992). Sheet says RouteAccuracy=high/mapped route but routes-repo P3657.geojson is an empty placeholder - this fills missing geometry, not a replacement. Datum: blueprint EPSG:2039->WGS84 exact; NtM datum unstated, WGS84 assumed (NtM convention). [APPLIED 2026-07-23: geometry to GOIT-GGIT-pipeline-routes main (merge 72d29de1), sheet RouteAccuracy/RouteNotes/Route [ref] via Sheets API.]

source.name: TAMA 37/A/2/7 statutory blueprint GIS bundle (plan 1053432), Israel Land Registry

resolutions.researcher_notes: PARTIAL GEOMETRY - Ashdod side only. Midline of the green onshore pipeline strip (רצועת צנרת) color-segmented from the TAMA 37/A/2/7 onshore blueprint sheet, georeferenced by JGW world file (EPSG:2039 ITM, 0.42 m/px; exact registration, no GCP fit). Runs 1.51 km from the INGL Ashdod facility side (31.8490N 34.6793E) west to the HDD shore-crossing compound edge (31.8516N 34.6641E); matches the plan text 'כ-1.6 ק"מ ביבשה' (~1.6 km onshore; cabinet decision 1260 of 27.02.2022). EXPECTED LENGTH-RATIO FAIL vs the sheet's 4 km: per INGL (https://www.ingl.co.il/en/sea-line-project-ashdod-ashkelon/) the ~4 km onshore total splits between Ashdod beach (~1.6 km, covered here) and Ashkelon beach (~2.4 km, NOT covered - no public vector/blueprint found for the Ashkelon-side onshore run to the Ashkelon reception compound near Dorad/IPP; OSM has nothing usable; leave as ROUTE_PARTIAL for that side). The ~0.6 km HDD bore under the Ashdod beach was bridged by Baird 2026-07-23, so the line now ends at the marine tie-in (31.8543N 34.6590E = P3657 start); total 2.1 km, ratio 0.52. Suggested RouteAccuracy medium reflects the partial coverage; the covered portion itself is ±~20 m. [APPLIED 2026-07-23: geometry to GOIT-GGIT-pipeline-routes main (merge 72d29de1), sheet RouteAccuracy/RouteNotes/Route [ref] via Sheets API.]
